chunks: "From the reserved matter is completing the salat (prayer) in four places: Makkah, al-Madinah, Masjid al-Kufah, and the Ha'ir of al-Husayn عليه السلام."

key_terms.إِتْمَامُ الصَّلَاةِ: performing the salat (prayer) in full rather than shortened form
key_terms.الْأَمْرِ الْمَذْخُورِ: the reserved or specially designated ruling
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةِ: al-Madinah, the city of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.حَائِرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: the sacred precinct of al-Husayn عليه السلام
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ: the Mosque of Kufah, a sanctified mosque

ai.seo_question: In which places should a traveler complete the salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the traveler’s salat (prayer), specifying four sacred locations in which the prayer is to be performed in full. It highlights the special sanctity of Makkah, al-Madinah, Masjid al-Kufah, and the Ha'ir of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام in Shia fiqh.
